name: arithmetic-sprint
description: A 60-second arithmetic sprint: a small brain-training game with saved results and progress over time.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.reset: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:reset -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && oxlint e2e playwright.config.ts
